title: Pit Bulls Attack Woman During Terrifying Rampage
description:
A usual morning stroll turned into the scariest nightmare for this elderly woman when two pit bulls ambushed her from the sides and started mauling her. This is what happened next. A concerned citizen who was carrying a valid firearm shot at the two dogs before an officer could intervene. While one of them got severely injured and ran away, the other dog was unharmed and unwilling to move away from the bleeding woman. It sure was a tricky situation to handle and every time that the woman attempted to move away from the dog, it too would move closer to her while trying to bite down on her body.  The poor woman was contemplating death every passing second. The officers need to act quickly or it could all go very wrong. Around this time, the brown dog who was initially hit by the gunshots had succumbed to the injuries in his owner’s back yard. Both of these dogs had reportedly bitten several people over the past weeks.
